image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor). The image focuses on the anterior to mid-section of the fish, showing the characteristic black head and front body transitioning into a bright yellow posterior. The eye is visible on the far left edge, and the dorsal and anal fins are partially visible at the top and bottom edges respectively.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small protrusible mouth with brush-like teeth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is located at the very tip of the snout which is cut off by the left frame boundary; teeth are microscopic and not resolvable in this resolution.
The eye is visible on the extreme left edge. It appears proportionally large relative to the head section shown, consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed disc-shaped body with compact proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible curvature of the dorsal and ventral profiles indicates a deep, laterally compressed body typical of angelfish/butterflyfish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Striking gold and black coloration: anterior body and head black, posterior body and tail golden yellow with black margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays the diagnostic black anterior mask and yellow posterior body. The transition is sharp and distinct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous dorsal fin with spiny anterior and soft-rayed posterior portions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the base/root of the dorsal fin is visible at the top edge. The full length and ray structure are outside the frame.
Only the base of the anal fin is visible at the bottom edge. Full structure is occluded/out of frame.
The caudal peduncle and tail are completely outside the right frame boundary.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The black scales exhibit a slightly uniform, noisy 'static' texture rather than distinct individual scales, suggesting mild AI generation smoothing or upscaling artifacts.
The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), which is natural for macro photography, but the edges of the fins show slight haloing/bleeding into the background, common in generative models.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the subject is indeed Holocanthus tricolor and not a similar angelfish species.
To check for edge bleeding between the high-contrast black/yellow body and the background, and ensure fin continuity.
To assess the realism of the scale texture and lighting consistency.

focus_areas: Scale texture realism in the black vs yellow regions
Edge sharpness between fish and background
Anatomical correctness of the visible eye and fin bases
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the black scales; AI often renders dark areas as flat noise rather than structured scales. Verify if the eye shape is anatomically correct for a marine fish or if it shows 'melting' artifacts at the boundary.
